Orbitals – Main Theme "Accelerating Destiny" Official Music Video – Nintendo Switch 2
Orbitals arrives September 3, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2! Pre-order now: https://ninten.do/6002aKm1O 

Introducing the official music video for the main theme of Orbitals, vocalized by Japanese singer-songwriter Mami Ayukawa! 

In Orbitals, you and a friend play as Maki and Omura, exploring a universe inspired by retro anime. "Accelerating Destiny" (加速する運命) is the opening song that welcomes you the moment you start playing this co-op adventure. It captures the spirit of classic animation, creating otherworldly soundscapes that feel fresh yet familiar! 

#Orbitals
